description.value: Pho & Roll by Wooden Fish is a Vietnamese restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver, offering dine-in with table reservations and takeout pickup. The restaurant presents itself as a taste-forward Vietnamese experience, and also offers catering services. It sits on a busy arterial street convenient to several cycling routes in the Cambie corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 11 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (8 spaces) at 64m; stands (8 spaces) at 65m; stands (10 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (6 spaces) at 68m; rack (6 spaces) at 75m; rack (6 spaces) at 90m; rack (7 spaces) at 96m; rack (6 spaces) at 99m. enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is operational, showing a pickup option ('Pickup from 2323 Cambie Street'), a reservation page, and a catering request form. The phone number (604-658-4485) and address (2323 Cambie Street, Vancouver, BC V5Z2T9) on the website match the OSM record exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields are null; takeout is confirmed by the website's explicit pickup functionality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Vietnamese restaurant on the Cambie cycling corridor with a functioning website confirming pickup and dine-in service.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website footer shows an email address (eat@phoandroll.ca) not present in the OSM record — may be worth adding to the OSM entry.
